draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Kottakkal! The name means Land of the Fort, but the town got famous for something else: the Arya Vaidya Sala, one of the top Ayurvedic health centres in the world, opened here in 1902.
draft.hungryLine: Kottakkal is full of Kerala style restaurants, and you can't leave without a glass of avil milk.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Walk to the Juma Masjid, then on to the Kottakkal Viswambhara Temple and the Arya Vaidya Sala campus.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Grab an avil milk at V.H. Avilmilk Bakery in Chenguvetty and sip it slowly.
moodReplies.surprise-me: An Old Malayalam inscription from Kottakkal dates all the way back to 932.

legends.title: Land of the Fort
legends.body: Kottakkal literally means Land of the Fort. Today the town is better known for healing than for battles.

legends.title: Rites by the river
legends.body: On the north bank of the Bharatappuzha, Tirunavaya is one of the most important places in Kerala for bali tarpana on Karkitaka vavu. It's home to temples of Vishnu, Shiva and Brahma.

tips.title: Time it for the Pooram.
tips.body: Kottakkal Pooram, the town's popular temple festival, runs for seven days in March to April.

tips.title: Visit the Kunhali Marakkar Memorial.
tips.body: The Indian Navy built it to honour the Kunhali Marakkars, who fought foreign invaders of Malabar in the 16th century.

story.title: Words in stone
story.body: An Old Malayalam inscription from Kottakkal dates back to the year 932. People have been leaving their mark here for over a thousand years.

story.title: Sea fighters
story.body: The Kunhali Marakkars resisted foreign invaders on the Malabar coast. A memorial built by the Indian Navy remembers them.

story.title: The Arya Vaidya Sala opens
story.body: The founding of the Arya Vaidya Sala made Kottakkal famous. Its name means Holy Medical Campus.

story.title: A growing hub
story.body: Kottakkal is a municipality of 32 wards on National Highway 66, and a big health, education and trade centre for South Malabar. It even has the 400 bed Almas Hospital.

story.title: Sip and stroll
story.body: Walk past the mosques and temples, peek at the Arya Vaidya Sala, then cool down with avil milk. Tell me if you finished the glass.
